text:
**Findings**

| Severity | File:lines | Issue |
|---|---:|---|
| high | [lumen/client.py](/work/lumen/client.py:77) 77-91, 180-197 | `_request` retries non-idempotent POSTs, so a retry after a partial server failure can duplicate task creation or reviews. |
| high | [lumen/client.py](/work/lumen/client.py:172) 172, 195, 224, 241 | Resource IDs are interpolated into URLs without path escaping, allowing IDs containing `/`, `?`, or `#` to change the request path/query. |
| medium | [lumen/client.py](/work/lumen/client.py:78) 77-91 | Transport errors and timeouts from `httpx` are not retried or wrapped in `LumenAPIError`, so callers get inconsistent exception behavior. |
| medium | [lumen/client.py](/work/lumen/client.py:185) 185-192 | `batch_create` materializes the full iterable before chunking, which contradicts the “any iterable” API and can exhaust memory on large inputs. |
| medium | [lumen/client.py](/work/lumen/client.py:164) 164-167, 198-200, 225-229 | Malformed or missing response items are silently skipped, causing hidden data loss instead of a clear client/API error. |
| medium | [lumen/models.py](/work/lumen/models.py:49) 49-55, 91-97, 119-125, 137-144, 157-162 | Response model parsing trusts enum/status fields and required schema shape, so invalid API data is accepted under misleading type hints. |
| medium | [pyproject.toml](/work/pyproject.toml:24) 24-25 | The package claims to be typed but does not ship a `py.typed` marker, so downstream type checkers may ignore its inline types. |
| low | [lumen/client.py](/work/lumen/client.py:104) 104-113 | `Retry-After` only supports numeric seconds and ignores the standard HTTP-date form. |
| low | [lumen/models.py](/work/lumen/models.py:40) 40-82, 106-126 | Frozen dataclasses expose mutable dict fields directly, so model instances are not actually immutable in practice. |
| low | [tests/test_client.py](/work/tests/test_client.py:61) 61-263 | Tests cover the main happy paths but miss path escaping, malformed responses, network failures, PEP 561 packaging, and non-idempotent retry behavior. |

**Score:** 5.5/10.

The code is readable, compact, and the existing tests pass once dependencies are installed outside the read-only workspace: `9 passed`. But I would not approve this as-is for production-facing client code. The main blockers are unsafe retry semantics for POST requests, unescaped path parameters, and weak failure handling around transport errors and malformed API responses.

Estimated rewrite/significant-change size: about 125 lines.

issues.description: _request retries non-idempotent POSTs, risking duplicate task creation or duplicate reviews after partial failures.
Resource IDs are interpolated into URLs without path escaping, so special characters can alter the path or query.
httpx transport errors and timeouts are not retried or wrapped in the client's typed exception hierarchy.
batch_create materializes the entire iterable before chunking, which can exhaust memory and contradicts the public API docs.
Malformed or missing response items are silently skipped instead of raising a clear API/client error.
Model parsers trust enum/status values and schema shape, accepting invalid API data under misleading type hints.
Typed package does not ship a py.typed marker, so downstream type checkers may ignore its inline types.
Retry-After parsing ignores the standard HTTP-date form and only handles numeric seconds.
Frozen dataclasses expose mutable dict fields directly, so instances are not deeply immutable.
Tests miss coverage for escaping, malformed responses, network failures, packaging typing, and retry safety.
